adoption.rationale: Pinned implementation, opt-in plugin wiring, functional regression test, changelog, and frozen source windows independently support this narrow validator guarantee; trust remains application caller config and no remote security impact is claimed.

contract.declared_domain: Formal domain: one ASCII code unit drawn from U+0000..U+001F or U+007F, proving that every such code unit is matched by the pinned regex. Product replay domain: plain objects with one own enumerable key whose string value is drawn from all one- and two-code-unit ASCII strings plus seeded longer, Unicode, C1, and ordinary examples. The guarantee depends on search semantics and the pinned helper's explicit regex check; it does not cover validateStartArgs, route generation, non-string values, or remote reachability.
contract.guarantee: For every own enumerable string-valued navigation parameter, validateNavigateParams throws TypeError if the value contains any ASCII C0 control code unit (U+0000 through U+001F) or DEL (U+007F), as detected by the exact pinned CONTROL_CHARS_RE search before the params object is accepted.
contract.input_source: String values in the params object supplied by an application caller to the opt-in validation plugin's validateNavigateParams callback. This is caller-provided configuration/API input; this contract makes no claim that a remote attacker controls it.

domain: Every one-code-unit ASCII C0 or DEL character is matched by the exact pinned search regex used for string navigation parameter values
